ordered_goals.target: isolated audit checkout and local API
ordered_goals.objective: E1: Establish an attributable functional and evolution baseline without claiming unavailable live proof
acceptance_criteria: Record local source identity, runtime profile and previous verification artifact hashes
Record current GitHub main reference and live public reachability separately
Record dependencies and unavailable channels explicitly; no failed prerequisite counted as passed

ordered_goals.target: actual route registration, channel contracts and domain semantics
ordered_goals.objective: E2: Validate every registered route against its intended behavior and consumers
acceptance_criteria: Enumerate actual method and path pairs independently of source regex inventory
Execute authorization and shape checks separately from semantic state assertions
Every route has domain execution evidence or an explicit unresolved or intentional limitation; registration is not semantic verification

ordered_goals.objective: E3: Close meaningful browser-to-domain-to-runtime workflows with persistence and error recovery
acceptance_criteria: Exercise meaningful controls on every inventoried dashboard page
Verify resulting domain state, refresh, restart, permissions and failures
Separate rendered, simulated, unavailable and actually executed capabilities

ordered_goals.target: existing self-improvement, goal, loop, maker and checker services
ordered_goals.objective: E4: Make DjimFlo execute a controlled product improvement through its own governed workflow
acceptance_criteria: Observed reproducible defect reaches an evidence-bound proposal, goal and loop
Isolated real implementation and independent checks produce attributable artifacts
Failed attempts and authority boundaries persist; no mock execution claimed as provider engineering capability

ordered_goals.target: measured evaluation and subsequent decision use
ordered_goals.objective: E5: Demonstrate content-level improvement over a fixed baseline on unseen tasks and subsequent decisions
acceptance_criteria: Predeclare metric, baseline, held-out cases, minimum effect and comparable runtime conditions
Measure with-versus-without candidate and retained failed or inconclusive results
Trace accepted learning into a later real decision and distinguish causal evidence from labels or structural scores
No relevant regression; insufficient evidence remains undetermined and cannot authorize promotion

ordered_goals.target: existing loop execution and verification lifecycle
ordered_goals.objective: E6: Repeatedly verify functional and evolution outcomes without duplicate execution or silent regression
acceptance_criteria: Relevant checks run after changes, full regression after integration and outcome evaluation after candidate runs
Repeated control survives restart and rejects overlapping or replayed work
Regression triggers explicit hold or rejection through existing authority; no autonomous protected deployment
Record actual trigger/run evidence; no claimed background monitor without a running supported mechanism
